description: A minimalist, high-contrast mobile app designed for tracking job applications efficiently. Emphasizes data clarity, typography, and functional beauty with seamless AI integrations.

ux_patterns.navigation: Bottom Tab Navigation with 4 tabs: Home (Kanban), Add, Analytics, Profile. Use a persistent floating action button (FAB) for quick add actions if preferred.
ux_patterns.kanban_board: On mobile, use a horizontal paging scroll view where each page represents a column (Applied, Interview, etc.). Inside each column, use a vertical list for cards. Use a 'long-press to drag' interaction pattern, or simply tap a card to open an edit modal to change its status easily.
ux_patterns.smart_detection_popup: Use a smooth bottom sheet (gorhom/bottom-sheet) that slides up automatically when the app detects an intent share, parsed email, or newly analyzed screenshot. Show the 'ai_detection_graphic' image at the top of the sheet, present extracted data in a read-only minimalist list, and provide large ✅ Add / ❌ Ignore buttons.
ux_patterns.animations: Minimalist and snappy. Use layout animations (Reanimated) for list reordering. Apply subtle opacity fades (0ms-200ms) for modal entrances.
ux_patterns.accessibility: Ensure all form inputs have accessible labels. Use 'data-testid' on ALL interactive elements (e.g., 'data-testid="job-card"', 'data-testid="add-application-button"'). Respect device dynamic type and dark mode preferences.

app_logo.description: Minimalist geometric logo of a target and briefcase, perfect for the splash screen and header.

auth_background.description: Abstract elegant geometric pattern for the login/signup screen background.

empty_state_jobs.description: 3D minimalist rendering of an empty desk with a folder. Use in the Kanban board when a column is empty.

ai_detection_graphic.description: Abstract glowing blue laser scanning data blocks. Use in the Smart Detection Popup/Bottom Sheet.

default_company_logo.description: Default placeholder for company logos when the exact logo is unavailable.

default_user_avatar.description: Default placeholder for the user profile avatar.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements must include a 'data-testid' attribute.
